title: Cancellation and hold
summary: Host abort retains custody until the interrupted case records starting_state_restore: restored=true for its baseline. Removed missions finish through walk-end: a removed walking execution that holds any host, a lease or a reserved host turn, keeps its waits, turns and leases under a recorded abort, so no next waiter is served mid-walk; a removed execution that is only waiting returns its turn at once. Cleanup finish and deliberate manual QA_HOST release end custody; unproven restoration records reset_owed for the case baseline, defaulting to fresh-host. The next holder resets before any case or mission. Failed recovery records machine_needs_repair and the reset command in evidence and steering. A later successful reset clears debt. Source tests are not deployed proof. After a terminal deployment run, the original session may abort or finish walk-end; release reasons name run status. Settled executions report their state, while ordinary writes require an active stage. Ordinary failed restores and terminal captures missing restore proof also record debt before custody ends. Successful intermediate chain captures retain state for their followers. A live steering seat stops another session's live execution through the same stop request instead of settling it: the receipt's stop_request names the owner session, and the owner's runner stops at its next case check-in or host heartbeat, cleans up and settles under steering-stop-requested naming the requesting session. Without a seat the abort refuses with qa_execution_stop_requires_steering and names the steering path. A walking mission without a recorded restore is stopped the same way by its owner or a steering seat: the abort records cancellation and keeps the lease and mission access, a steering abort returns stop_request, the owner's own abort refuses qa_abort_walk_end_required, each access reply carries a mission_walk_stopped notice naming the cleanup still owed, and the original session's walk-end releases the host and settles the abort under its reason. Before any walk, a mission whose admitted docket preparation has checked in is host work too: the abort refuses qa_abort_restore_pending and the execution keeps its own lease, not a lapsing hold-over, so no other admission gets the lab; the runner lets its blocking baseline call finish, stops at the next phase boundary, restores the declared baseline unless it just proved it, and its mission.ready docket carries that starting_state_restore receipt, which settles the abort without opening a walk. The runner checks in before it powers on a cloud Test Machine, so that custody covers the driver and every companion lease through power-on; a cancelled or ended execution stops before power-on, and the power call beats and is cancelled at its boundary. An admission with no check-in yet still aborts at once, and the owner's compact abort receipt lists the hosts its session keeps as test_machine_holdovers. A case whose runner raised before recording a run reads failed, and its raw_result.error_code names the runner's own error code (for example starting_state_restore_failed), else the abort reason's code. A plan group walk stopped after its last attacher left the run still settles; its pending capture review goes to the run's driver, else the session that started the run, else steering.
